profileDecisions.codexChromeProfile: Codex exposes chrome-extension-builder instead of product-platform; other live profiles expose product-platform. This keeps the router and its independently triggerable leaf out of the same bundle result.
profileDecisions.interactionMetadata: disable-model-invocation is received only by Claude, its identified consumer; non-Claude bundles omit the three interaction packages rather than relying on unknown-key behavior.

agents.composeMetadataTransform: The copied native descriptions are flattened to one YAML line without changing their text.

providerNativeExceptions.retiredDocumentation: The historical Agents maestri and maestri-portal exceptions are not present in the live overlay. Canonical maestri supersedes the former and maestri-portal is archive-only.

excludedGeneratedOutputs.providers/codex-routed: Generated non-install output, including stale release children; it is not a provider root or catalog exposure surface.
excludedGeneratedOutputs.providers/opencode: Placeholder outside the supported install-root set.
